Evaluate a prioritization

Source: R/fct_eval_prioritization.R
eval_prioritization.Rd

Evaluate a prioritization according to how well its represents features, locks, and costs. Additionally, area-based metrics are calculated.

Usage

eval_prioritization(project, prioritization)

Arguments

project

new_project() object to which prioritization should be added.

prioritization

numeric vector with a value for each planning unit to indicate zone allocations.

Value

A list object. This is a list with a "summary" element that contains a data frame with area-based metrics, as well as "features", "locks", and "costs" elements that contain data frames with metrics for the features, locks, and costs (respectively).

See also

Other functions for prioritization: solve_prioritization()

Examples

# simulate data
project <- simulate_project()

# generate a simulated prioritization
prioritization <- sample.int(
  length(project$zones), project$dataset$get_n_pu(), replace = TRUE
)

# evaluate prioritization
eval_prioritization(project, prioritization)
